rev.t: Joined yoga for couple months.  Instructor is knowledgeable and good. Only issue is most of the instructions is in Kannada.  No english or Hindi. If you don’t know Kannada, you can still figure out few things.

The place offers :
Gym : can be highly recommend as the fitness trainers and schedules are very much scientifically made out . …

I started here around 6 months ago
My overall health and fitness is has improved drastically
My trainer Praveen sir has been motivated me to keep on going
I couldn’t be less happy
